newsitem.title: USA: CME hogs and pork bellies expected steady to lower.
newsitem.headline: CME hogs and pork bellies expected steady to lower.

text.p: CME lean hog futures were expected to open steady to 0.100 cent per lb lower and pork bellies steady to 0.200 lower, livestock analysts said.
Although trade may be light in hog futures as the market waits to see how cash trends develop after the holiday, steady to lower indications for cash hogs will likely weigh on futures, analysts said.
Lower pork cutout values late last week should keep packer demand for hog cautious.

Pork belly futures were also expected to show early pressure on a drop in cash pork belly values late last week. Cash bellies dipped to $84 per cwt after trading up to $90 earlier in the week. The cash market again hit resistance at the $90 per cwt area which cuts off user interest, they said.
Hog slaughter at above year-ago levels also has been weighing on price sentiment, they added.
